title: Number of Installments by Comfort Club Membership — Repair and Emergency Service Calls Arrangements
content:
**Arrangement terms.** For a payment arrangement on a past-due Repair and Emergency Service Calls balance, the number of installments follows the customer's Comfort Club agreement under Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements. The records read are the agreement's status and its consecutive terms, which count the current term and are held without a break.

**Rule.** The number of installments is 3 for a customer whose active Comfort Club agreement has run six or more consecutive terms. It is 2 for any other customer with an active agreement, and 1 for every other customer.

| Customer | Consecutive terms | Number of installments |
|---|---|---|
| Active agreement | 6 or more | 3 |
| Active agreement | 1 to 5 | 2 |
| No active agreement | — | 1 |

## Boundaries

- An active member in the 6th consecutive term has 3 installments. In the 5th term the member has 2.
- A member whose agreement is past due or lapsed has no active agreement and has 1 installment.
